nodes.text: Hold up. New face at the north gate — you get the speech. Short version: this wall is where the settled land ends. Every mile north is meaner than the last. Goblins in the foothills. Wolves under the Thornveil. Past the Last Lamp — things I don't name in reports. I number them.

The Waykeepers hold three walled lamps on the way north — *Fernway*, the *Long Meadow*, the *Fork*. Walk lamp to lamp. Sleep behind their walls. The day the road stops feeling tired and starts feeling _interested in you_, turn around. That's the speech. What you do with it is yours.
Good. See Hask across the way before you go — sound boots have kept more travelers alive than sound swords. Road keep you.
Mm. They all say that. I'll keep a page free in the incident book. Prove me wrong — I'd like that, honestly.
